Allu Arjun to appear virtually in 'Pushpa' stampede case

The News Minute, The Times of India, and Republic World report that Allu Arjun is expected to miss the Nampally Court hearing on the Sandhya Theatre stampede. His legal team will seek virtual participation due to his ongoing film shoot.
